text: In January 2024, a brand-new Boeing jet lost a piece of its wall in mid-air. It was a "door plug": a panel that fills a spare emergency-exit hole. It's held in place by four bolts. Investigators found the bolts were never put back after a repair at the factory. At sixteen thousand feet, the cabin pressure pushes on every square centimetre of that panel. With nothing holding it, it blew out. Air rushed out, and so did anything loose. By pure luck, the two seats next to it were empty. Everyone on board survived. And a passenger's iPhone fell sixteen thousand feet, landed in someone's yard, and still worked.
